_note: WRITTEN 2026-09-22, AFTER THE FACT, and derived from the records rather than typed -- which is the second-best way to have a manifest and the reason this one says so. Every other arm in runs/ was manifested before its first call; this one, the arm every headline number is computed from, had none. Its actual parameters were recoverable only from the records and from commit 6e9f948d, so `wave.py --verify` reported 100% of the corpus as parameter drift against a frozen spec the collector had correctly overridden. Fields below are read back and asserted single-valued where the design fixes them; where they are not single-valued, the distribution is given instead of a value.
analysis_seed_note: DECLARED AT THE VALUE ALREADY IN USE, not chosen. This manifest carried no analysis_seed, so every bootstrap over this wave has been running on studypaths.LEGACY_SEED (20260527) by silent fallback since 2026-09-16. Writing any other number here would move every resampled figure in the paper, so the seed is recorded rather than re-picked: the May date is the provenance of the constant, not of this collection. The gap was invisible because the collector stamps schema battery-run/1, which validate_runs read as another workstream and exempted from this rule entirely.
max_tokens_note: TWO VALUES, and the split is declared in PROTOCOL-DEVIATIONS.md. 32768 is the pass run_battery refused partway as below the measured safe budget of 34,536; those 120 records are ten models at twelve each and are NOT truncated -- longest output 5,481 tokens, none within ten of the cap, none classified truncated. 40960 is the raised cap the rest was collected at, against a longest actual output of 35,002.
seeds_note: Collected in five passes over several days, each sweeping consecutive seeds from its own base. The frozen spec names one `seed_base`, which cannot express that; what the design fixes is distinct seeds PER CELL and that is what --verify gates.
